description: Hi-hat voice built from a resonant band-pass filter that is pinged by each trigger, with noise or a patched signal pushing the filter frequency down while the ping rings

params.text: Sets the frequency the filter is pinged at, 20Hz to 20000Hz
Sets the resonance of the filter, and with it how long each ping rings on; it also sets how long the gate feeding the filter's modulation stays open, from 10ms to 510ms
Sets how far the gated modulation signal pushes the filter frequency, and the push is always downward from the FREQ setting
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the frequency jack, -1 to +1, before it is added to the FREQ knob
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the decay jack, -1 to +1, before it is added to the DECAY knob
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the FM amount jack, -1 to +1, before it is added to the FM AMT knob
Silences the output; the lamp on it is lit while the output is silenced
Chooses what the gate feeding the filter's modulation is fed from: pink noise at the bottom of its travel, whatever is patched into the FM jack in the middle, and blue noise at the top

inputs.text: A signal for the gate to pass into the filter's frequency modulation; it reaches the gate only as far as the LPG IN MIX knob lets it
Added to the FREQ knob through the trimmer beside it, one volt per octave
Added to the DECAY knob through the trimmer beside it, 10V covering the knob's whole travel; the total is held between the two ends of it
A rising edge through 1V pings the filter and opens the output amplifier
Added to the FM AMT knob through the trimmer beside it, 10V covering the knob's whole travel; the total is held between the two ends of it

outputs.text: The voice, the pinged filter through the output amplifier and the volume trimmer

menu: VCA Attack Time — a slider setting how quickly the output amplifier opens on each trigger, 0.5ms to 20ms, starting at about 6ms
